jobDescription: A credit card issuer screens every card-not-present transaction with a fraud model and a set of strategy rules before authorisation. The fraud analytics team retrains the model, sets alert thresholds with the fraud strategy managers and reports detection performance to the model risk committee. The data scientist will build training data from confirmed fraud reports, retrain and recalibrate the model, analyse how the strategy rules perform and prepare committee material. Detection results are compared at a fixed alert rate over defined periods.
requirements: Builds labelled training data from confirmed fraud and chargeback records, including first-party fraud labels.
Retrains and recalibrates a card fraud model with the fraud strategy team.
Shows a measured change in fraud detection at a fixed alert rate over defined comparison periods.
Analyses strategy-rule performance and proposes rule retirements.
Prepares model performance material for a model risk committee.

evidence.text: Built the labelled training set for the card-not-present fraud model at Saltire Card Services, joining confirmed fraud reports and chargeback reason codes to transactions with a 90-day label delay.
Retrained the gradient-boosted fraud model on 2022 data and recalibrated its alert thresholds with the fraud strategy managers over a series of threshold workshops.
Reviewed the performance of 64 strategy rules and proposed retiring 17 that rarely fired or duplicated the model; the fraud strategy managers approved 15 of them.
Prepared the quarterly model performance paper for the model risk committee, covering detection, alert volumes and drift indicators.
Mentored two graduate analysts on SQL and feature engineering for transaction data.

Work sample: notes from the threshold workshops, with the alert-rate options considered, the chosen operating point of 0.5% of transactions alerted, and the fraud strategy managers' sign-off on the recalibrated thresholds.

HR verification note: the model performance memo the candidate mentioned at interview was obtained directly from Saltire Card Services' model risk office. At a fixed alert rate of 0.5%, it records card-not-present fraud value detected rising from 61% (January to March 2023) to 74% (July to September 2023), after the retrained model went into use in May 2023.
Recruiter logistics note: the candidate is available for the final panel on 23 or 24 October and has asked for the case exercise to be sent in advance.
